title: Kernel Formula for Conditional Expectation
statement:
Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces, with strictly positive coordinate weights $w_i$ summing to $1$. For a coordinate subset $S$, a real-valued function $f$ on the product outcome space, and an outcome $x$, the conditional expectation is
\[E_Sf(x)=\sum_y\left(\prod_i k_i(x,y)\right)f(y),\qquad k_i(x,y)=\begin{cases}\mathbf 1_{x_i=y_i},&i\in S,\\ w_i(y_i),&i\notin S.\end{cases}\]
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space
All coordinate weights are strictly positive and sum to $1$
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
$f$ is real-valued on the product outcome space
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$ with coordinate weights $w_i$, $S\subseteq[n]$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then $E_Sf(x)=\sum_y[\prod_{i\in S}\mathbf1_{x_i=y_i}\prod_{i\notin S}w_i(y_i)]f(y)$ for every $x\in\Omega$.
